title: Interactive Calendar Cards
description: A column of month cards, each showing a randomized grid of contribution-style pads with a few colored 'active' cells. Clicking an active pad triggers gsap.to to scale it up 20x to flood-fill the card, then reveals an image, title, copy and link that fly in with a staggered elastic.out gsap.fromTo (y and random rotation); a Back button reverses the animation.

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para una lista de tarjetas mensuales tipo calendario donde cada celda de una cuadrícula abre, al hacer clic, una ficha con imagen, texto y enlace con rebote elástico.

motion.title: Interactive Calendar Cards
motion.motion_signature: click-scaled pad flood-fill (scale 20 in 0.3s, contained by the card's overflow:hidden), then a 2s elastic.out staggered fromTo of 3 content blocks from y:100 with a per-element random rotation (-30..30); Back reverses as a nested chain (fade 0.2s -> unscale 0.3s -> clearProps). No scroll-driven motion at all.
